title: coding-agent-attempt/2: one delegated attempt in data/evaluation/coding-agent-attempts.jsonl
description: One row per delegated attempt: a worker, reviewer or explorer the lead chose for one task. A matched run's two attempts are a pair: the same Ready leaf, brief and base commit given to a routing row's first choice and to one challenger, each in its own worktree; the two rows share issue, base commit and kind of work, and only they carry a blind preference. The procedure is in docs/operations/matched-runs.md and the reading rules are in docs/operations/model-routing.md. `model` and `effort` are the names the curator and player-host configurations use; `wall_seconds` is the run ledger's.

issue.description: The GitHub issue of the task the delegate was given; a matched run's two attempts share it.

kind_of_work.description: The routing table's row for this task, its first cell verbatim.

base_commit.description: The commit the delegate started from; a matched run's two worktrees share it.

role.description: The role the delegate was given; locator is the explorer role in its locating form.

coding_agent.description: The coding agent that ran the attempt, as the coding-agent hosts page names it.

coding_agent_version.description: The coding agent's version as it reports it; null when it could not be started to say.

model.description: The model identifier the coding agent was given for the attempt.

effort.description: The effort the attempt ran at, in the hosts' shared vocabulary; null when the coding agent exposes no effort setting.

reason.description: The reason the lead gave for choosing this delegate, as on the brief's Role line.

date.description: The day the attempt ran, as YYYY-MM-DD.

hand_back.description: How the delegate's last start ended, as the delegate call (tools/delegate.py) reported it.

acceptance.description: The result of the lead's own rerun of the brief's acceptance check on the attempt's final commit, whatever the attempt reported; null for a reviewer or explorer and for a worker that handed nothing back.

repairs.description: Repairs the lead had to ask for before the rerun passed, or before giving up.

wall_seconds.description: Wall time from handing over the brief to the attempt's last hand-back, repairs included.

blind_preference.description: For one of a matched run's two attempts, the clean-context reviewer's verdict on this attempt's diff against its pair's, read under neutral labels and mapped back afterwards; null for every other attempt.

outcome.description: For a worker, whether the lead merged this attempt or discarded it; for a reviewer or explorer, whether the lead acted on what it returned.

findings.description: A reviewer's findings as the lead dispositioned them; null for a worker or explorer.

false_report.description: What the attempt reported that was not so, such as a timeout reported as success or quoted text that exists nowhere in the tree or its cited source; null when its report held.

allOf.$comment: A matched pair is read by acceptance first, so each of its two attempts has one.
